question: Find all comments on well-finished posts (i.e., posts with non-null ClosedDate) that are tagged with '<machine-learning>'. For each such comment, return the comment text, the post title, and the display name of the commenter—but only if the commenter has never cast a downvote (DownVotes = 0). Additionally, include the average view count across all such qualifying posts.

prediction.sql: SELECT c."XCL_008" AS comment_text, p."XCL_035" AS post_title, u."XCL_055" AS display_name, (SELECT AVG(p2."XCL_030") FROM posts AS p2 WHERE p2."XCL_044" IS NOT NULL AND p2."XCL_036" LIKE '%<machine-learning>%') AS avg_view_count FROM comments AS c INNER JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026" INNER JOIN users AS u ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052" WHERE p."XCL_044" IS NOT NULL AND p."XCL_036" LIKE '%<machine-learning>%' AND u."XCL_062" = 0

FROM comments AS c
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
INNER JOIN users AS u ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052"
WHERE p."XCL_034" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."XCL_036" = '<machine-learning>'
  AND u."XCL_060" = 0
